male:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: four headless swordsman OUTFIT BODY key poses, one gender, for Aether pixel RPG.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET four-slot layout:2 columns×2 rows. Image2 is the approved basic costume DESIGN (green short cloak/ivory trim, plain iron breastplate, leather belt, dark fitted trousers, brown boots/gloves, one simple steel sword). Image3 is PixelLab QUALITY reference only, not its costume. Keep this starter design, no extra ornament or premium armor.
HEADLESS bodies only with fully COVERED HIGH CLOTH COLLAR: no head, face, hair, bare neck or shoulders/skin. Long sleeves meet fully closed gloves; trousers/boots cover legs/ankles. Separate heads will be fitted later, collar belongs to outfit. Do not paint a head or face into any frame.
Same lean adult proportions in all4, same limb lengths, torso/head socket scale, shoulder/waist/boot sizes, cloth/metal/leather pixel detail. Sharp native pixel clusters, no blur, smearing, painterly texture, glow, noisy microdots or thick outlines.
Reading order: top-left relaxed FRONT S standing sword one-hand carry, blade down toward screen-left; top-right FRONT S WALK CONTACT pose, gentle small step with left foot forward/right foot behind, heel lift and knee articulation clearly visible, stable right-hand sword carry with natural grip. Bottom-left FRONT S TWO-HAND OVERHEAD anticipation, BOTH hands gripping the same hilt straight above the missing head, sword axis VERTICAL straight up, blade aligned with wrists, feet planted. Bottom-right FRONT S TWO-HAND decisive downward cleave FINISH, hands follow down in front, sword tips toward down-left/front, controlled small knee bend, head socket remains forward/upright. No floating sword, grip behind fingers, guard ahead, same sword size in all4. The last pose is an impact/finish key, not arm waving.
PADDING/REGISTRATION: logical sheet768square, each cell384square, foot/root cell(192,336), neutral collar/neck cell(192,234). Standing neck-to-sole102 logical pixels; same bone sizes in the other poses, knees may bend. Body occupies lower third of each cell, NOT enlarged to fill it. Reserve ample empty head/overhead sword space; every silhouette at least30logical pixels from every cell boundary. Never let a raised sword cross a row boundary or touch another actor. Same camera and scale throughout, NO per-pose zoom/reframing. True transparent alpha, no grids/labels/text/background/shadow.
GENDER: adult MALE body, slim practical shoulders and straight fitted waist/hips, lean limbs; not bulky. Same height and neck socket as female version.
